Trovati 10 file documentazione esistenti: README.md, CLAUDE.md, project-context.md, 7 docs/ files da aggiornare.
Backend: Django 5.1.6 + DRF 3.15.1 + PostgreSQL 16 + MinIO + SimpleJWT + moviepy + APScheduler. Frontend: Next.js 16.1.6 + React 19 + TailwindCSS 4 + React Query + shadcn/ui + framer-motion.

Deep scan: 35 endpoint API, 5 modelli dati, 52 componenti frontend, state management completo. 4 documenti scritti: api-contracts-backend.md, data-models-backend.md, component-inventory-frontend.md, state-management-frontend.md.

2 documenti architettura: architecture-backend.md (monolith API-centric, ViewSet, auth, scheduler) e architecture-frontend.md (App Router, design system, state, responsive).
